answer: Identity bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities: each identity posts a bond that decays over time, refreshed only by real work, so idle fakes bleed money. A new identity plants its bond in a grove, trades with a reef of counterparties, and honest work restores it like jade. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits, 1,000 bonds at 50 each, lost to decay. An honest agent pays one 50-credit bond, refreshed by work, its share undiluted.
